notes.title: Crossplatform Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Hello Wejammers

This update includes some minor enhancements and cross-platform compatibility with the Nintendo Switch Version.

Have fun!

notes.title: Let's keep jammin'
notes.content:
Dear WEJAMmers and Noise-Makers

We have a nice little update for you again.

[i]New stuff[/i]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuned all Instruments and Beats and added some cool new ones
[*] Added the option to use no beat at all
[*] Flashy transition when connecting
[*] Cute little animal avatars
[/list]

[i]Fixed stuff: [/i]
[list]
[*] Private Session were not connecting
[*] Various fixes and improvements under the hood
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy it!

On a side note, Hyperglide is currently on a 75% sale: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638520/Hyperglide/

notes.title: New WEJAM Update
notes.content:
Hey WEJAMMERS

We just published an update with the following features:
[list]
[*]Loopy - An easy to use looper that copies what you play in single player mode
[*]A small design refresh
[*]Translations in German, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Private Sessions - Give a code you your friend to jam in private
[*]Play with A S D F keys
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the comments.
Thanks
